title: Matte Black 30-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar - Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Collection (Traditional), Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop settling for flimsy towel bars and mismatched finishes—this 30-inch wall mount towel bar delivers a polished, coordinated look, backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs.

  • Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Enjoy lasting durability—solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Coordinate your space: part of the Carolina collection for matching Carolina, traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories
  • Choose the finish that fits your room with multiple designer finish options available

Specs

  • Product type: Bathroom towel bar (straight bar)
  • Size: 30 Inch
  • Center-to-center: 30 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Material: Brass
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Carolina collection.
meta_description: 30-inch wall mount towel bar in solid brass with concealed screws and traditional style. Part of the Carolina collection. Limited Lifetime Warranty.
